summary.text: Ryan Rose is a Republican state representative from Arkansas House District 48 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Hunter Jackson is also on the ballot. A pastor and small business owner from Van Buren, Rose also worked as an adjunct professor at the University of the Ozarks.

paragraphs.text: Rose lives in Van Buren, Arkansas, and graduated from Port Aransas High School in 2003.
He earned bachelor's degrees in communications from the University of the Ozarks in 2007 and in pastoral ministry and leadership from Global University in 2020.

His career experience includes owning and operating Rose Auto Sales VB, serving as associate pastor of Evangel Temple Assembly of God Church, working as a development and marketing strategist for Union Christian Academy, and serving as an adjunct professor of communications and technical advisor at the University of the Ozarks.
Rose assumed office in the Arkansas House on January 9, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session Rose was assigned to the House Advanced Communications and Information Technology Committee, the House Public Health, Welfare and Labor Committee, the House State Agencies and Governmental Affairs Committee, the Legislative Council, the Joint Energy Committee and the Boys State Committee.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Rose described himself as a husband, father, pastor and Van Buren resident, and said he was running as a conservative Republican on priorities that included lower taxes, protecting the unborn, supporting law enforcement, Second Amendment rights and access to education.
